Embedding request with explicit dimensions parameter returns embeddings of the requested size

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.embed_async(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(dimensions: 256, input: 'Hello world', model: 'text-embedding-3-small'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].embedding.inspect
```
